data.narrative:
Sygaldry Technologies is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Chad Rigetti, Idalia Friedson, and Michael Keiser. The target sector comprises 3 public comps (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression valuation was the applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $139M as a proxy for post-money valuation at seed/early stage, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $278M. This method assumes the company's next institutional round will command a standard progression multiple over deployed capital.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable. While 8 quantum computing peers exist in the dataset, none of the narrow filters—same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—produced the minimum 3 datapoints required for robust statistical comparison. Drawing a median from the full sector set would obscure stage and valuation-tier heterogeneity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $236M to $320M, with a median of $278M. This narrow output reflects reliance on a single methodological pillar. Key uncertainties include capital deployment efficiency relative to peer cohorts, technical differentiation versus the five named private competitors, and runway relative to Series B fundraising timelines. Obtaining comparable transaction multiples or revenue metrics from the private peer set would strengthen conviction.
